category: client-intake workflow SaaS for independent consultants and small service teams
product_summary: A reusable client-intake form, follow-up, record, and status workflow that clients can use without creating an account.

capabilities: Reusable forms built from templates or from scratch
New, Waiting on Client, Ready, and Complete statuses
Owner assignment, internal notes, and client updates
Branded intake links and website embedding
Unlimited forms, 500 active client records, two team members, and email support
limitations: No security certifications or regulatory compliance claims are stated
No custom automation beyond stated missing-answer reminders is stated
Pricing for more than two team members is not stated
Attachment limits and migration services are not stated
product_facts.activation_event: The account publishes or uses a real intake flow.
product_facts.purchase_event: The first settled $29 payment after the card-required trial.

offer.trial: 14 days; a card is required and the account converts to paid unless cancelled
offer.cancellation: Cancel from account settings at any time

market_context: The advertised traffic is cold Meta feed traffic, not a list of existing leads.
Potential alternatives include email, generic forms, documents, spreadsheets, CRMs, portals, and established workflow tools.
The product is most plausible when incomplete client information creates a recurring operational cost.
excluded_claims: Do not treat landing-page testimonials as representative market evidence.
Do not infer integrations, compliance, guaranteed time savings, guaranteed revenue, or universal workflow fit.
Do not infer that every professional service business has a current need, budget, authority, or willingness to switch.
